flow: Bounded original page-derived leaves -> host redaction leaf-by-leaf -> bounded safe aggregation -> existing BrowserObservation

bounds.truncation: Explicit truncated=false required; oversize raw data rejected rather than slicing raw sensitive leaves; public truncation only after sanitization.

surfaces.boundary: One original scalar page leaf; bounded 16384, Redact before public truncation.
Original TEXT leaves from private Summary; per-leaf Redact before host separators/aggregation/public truncation.
Private LABEL leaves for aria-label/aria-labelledby/associated labels/visible name fragments; redact each before join; canonical whole field also fenced after normalization.
Individual metadata string fields; each Redact individually. Public fixed discriminators/IDs/caps do not pass through redactor.
Form name uses same private nameLeaves. Raw formAction/method remain private fingerprint metadata, not public payload; no field/source dump added.
Product withholds page dialog message; exposes only suppressed dialog kind/status. Individual dialog scalar Redact before array projection.
PublicUrl strips userinfo/query/fragment; known values in publishable path/origin protected host-side. No URL leaf aggregated into text before fencing.
Suggested filename and MIME individual host-fenced scalar fields; private temporary path never projected. Name sanitization + redaction precede publication.
